mobbin:55941e7a-9532-47b7-bbe1-b5f8b7bca.summary: From idle remote viewfinder with camera status, user starts recording, HiLights a moment (full-screen confirmation), then returns to the live recording UI with elapsed timer and stop control.
steal: Idle: top strip shows remote camera storage remaining (3H:25), Wi‑Fi, and battery before start—preflight without leaving the control surface.
Recording: primary control morphs from red record circle to white-ring / red-square stop; elapsed time pill appears above the feed.
HiLight: one-thumb yellow mark button beside stop; momentary full-screen “HiLIGHT TAGGED” confirms the bookmark without opening a list.
Recording continues: red-dot + elapsed timer keeps recording state glanceable after the tag overlay dismisses.
avoid: Idle/recording viewfinder is a large black empty plane with tiny mode metadata (1080|24|10s|W)—faculty need named room/camera and clear live-preview status, not cryptic capture specs.
mobbin:55941e7a-9532-47b7-bbe1-b5f8b7bca.fit: Mobile wins as walk-around remote start/stop for room cameras (extends TouchPro; no phone app today)—HiLight maps to one-tap timestamped bookmarks during live take; keep big stop + unmistakable recording indicator.
